title: Continuous Action Practice
subject: English Language
objectives: Answer questions about what people are doing right now

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Ayo, what are you doing now?

lines.speaker: Ngozi
lines.text: I am going to the class.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Mohammed, which story are you reading?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Jide, what am I holding now?

lines.speaker: Jide
lines.text: You are holding Jibril's book, sir.

blocks.md: **Practice:** Look around you and describe what people are doing right now. 'He is ___.' 'They are ___.'

quiz.explain: Ayo says 'I am drawing a fly.'
Ngozi says 'I am going to the class.'
Jide says 'You are holding Jibril's book, sir.'
